name: ResultValue
description: A single figure or short text from a tool (a count, a state), or a withheld preview.

props.name: result
props.type: ResultBase & { type: "value"; label: string; value: string | number | null; unit?: string; detail?: string; redacted?: RedactedValue; }
props.description: The value result: a `label` and a number (shown as a metric with `unit`), a string, or `null` (shown as "—"); `redacted` replaces the value with the withheld treatment.
